extracted.intended_audience: AAAI-26 reviewers and program committee members (conference paper reviewers)
extracted.subtask_description: Ethical responsibilities and required conduct for reviewers evaluating submissions to the AAAI-26 conference, including conflict disclosure, impartiality, confidentiality, and standards for feedback. Intended to guide program committee members and invited reviewers in performing fair, timely, and professional peer review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fairness, lack of bias, and objectivity
rubrics_metrics.description: I will strive to be fair, unbiased, and objective in my evaluation of submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate submissions based on their merits and avoid letting personal opinions or biases influence the assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respectful and constructive feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: I will treat all authors with respect and provide constructive feedback in a professional and courteous manner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Feedback should be professional, courteous, focused on improvement, and avoid personal attacks or ad hominem remarks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of conflicts of interest
rubrics_metrics.description: I will disclose any conflicts of interest that may affect my ability to provide an impartial review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inform chairs promptly about any relationships or circumstances that could compromise impartiality (see related recusal rules).

rubrics_metrics.name: Decline if unqualified or if objectivity compromised
rubrics_metrics.description: If I am not qualified to review a paper or feel that my objectivity may be compromised, I will decline the invitation to review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only accept review assignments when you have the relevant expertise and can be impartial; decline otherwise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not review submissions from same institution or close collaborators
rubrics_metrics.description: I acknowledge that it is not permissible to review submissions that I suspect to be authored by authors from my own institution, or with whom I work, or have worked, closely.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid reviewing papers by current or recent colleagues, collaborators, or anyone where institutional/working relationships create an appearance of partiality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recuse and notify chairs for known conflicts
rubrics_metrics.description: If I suspect, or am aware of, a conflict of interest which may include prior co-authorship, a close professional relationship, or a personal relationship, I will promptly inform the chairs and exclude myself from the peer-review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promptly notify program chairs and recuse yourself from handling the submission when concrete conflicts (e.g., co-authorship, close personal/professional ties) exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Objective review without personal criticism and with actionable suggestions
rubrics_metrics.description: I commit to review all papers objectively and without personal criticism of the author. I will also strive to offer suggestions for improvement that will enhance the quality of the paper and to provide supporting arguments to my review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear, evidence-based critiques and concrete suggestions for improvement; base criticisms on the work, not the authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluate solely on academic merit irrespective of personal attributes
rubrics_metrics.description: I will evaluate papers solely on their academic merit, without regard to the authors’ personal characteristics, affiliations, or backgrounds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not consider authors' race, gender, nationality, institution prestige, or other personal attributes when judging the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain confidentiality and avoid misuse of review information
rubrics_metrics.description: I will maintain the confidentiality of the review process and respect the privacy of the authors and all involved in the evaluation. I will not use information obtained during the review process for personal advantage or disclose it to unauthorized individuals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep manuscript contents, reviews, and related communications private; do not share or exploit unpublished ideas or results seen during review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for plagiarism and report suspected cases
rubrics_metrics.description: I will carefully check the submissions for any indications of plagiarism, and if any such instances are suspected, I will inform the chairs immediately. I understand that plagiarism is a serious ethical violation and will take all necessary steps to ensure that the papers I review are original and make proper use of citations and quotes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be vigilant for unattributed text, recycled work, or improper citation; report concerns to chairs rather than attempting informal resolution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to guidelines, deadlines, and provide timely thorough feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: I will adhere to the guidelines and deadlines set forth by AAAI-26 Chairs and provide timely and thorough feedback to the authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete reviews by stated deadlines and ensure feedback is sufficiently detailed to be useful for authors and program decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Uphold highest standards of ethical conduct
rubrics_metrics.description: Overall, I commit to upholding the highest standards of ethical conduct in my role as a reviewer for conference papers, and I take this responsibility seriously.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Act with integrity, professionalism, and accountability throughout the review process; when in doubt about ethics, consult the chairs.
